parameters.name: EnableCreateDNSRecordInPvzt
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically create Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone records. Valid values:

>  If you enable automatic creation of PrivateZone records, a PrivateZone record is automatically created when you associate a VPC with the instance.

*   `true`
*   `false`

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

*   `Registry`: image repositories.
*   `Chart`: Helm charts.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch that is associated with the specified VPC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-instance-vpc-endpoint-linked-vpc --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --vpc-id vpc-uf6pa68zxnnlc48dd0000 --vswitch-id vsw-uf6u0kn8x2gbzxfn20000 --module-name Registry --enable-create-dns-record-in-pvzt false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateInstanceVpcEndpointLinkedVpc --region cn-hangzhou --VpcId 'vpc-uf6pa68zxnnlc48dd0000' --EnableCreateDNSRecordInPvzt false --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --ModuleName Registry --VswitchId 'vsw-uf6u0kn8x2gbzxfn20000'
